questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Coming from Denmark the reformation and Luther especially is very big throughout the whole kingdom. It was very intriguing to explore and understand the city of the reformation in person.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Our teacher send out an emial with the opportunity of travelling there as a part of a BIP course-format. The student-administration at my faculty did all the paperwork and work regarding merit for my education. It went really smoothly. I only had to fill out all the information in the mobility-online program.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Alot from the administration and the teacher who recommended the course.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was interesting for sure. The group work at the host institution was very well recieved, which we dont have as much of at UCPH. Also having such a diverse student-group was very interesting when exploring a person like Luther.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be well prepared academically before you leave. Reflect on what you want to get out of the course. Be open to new friendships - be social!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: That you should definitely be prepared and have read all the litterature beforehand. Alså bring cash for buying food and souveniers.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting new people and experiencing the format; that you only focus on one course for a whole week - having interesting conversations and going deep into the topics.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: For me; being available all the time. The schedule was full and interesting, but the social battery would run out at the end of the day.
